hypothesis.name: Absolute raw-binding evidence with independently held-out TRAIN calibration
hypothesis.claim: The F126-R no-null evidence has positive pair ranking but failed the frozen decision boundary. A separate fixed affine calibrator trained only on a source-disjoint TRAIN calibration split may improve absolute positive/negative classification without using paired labels at inference.
hypothesis.new_mechanism: All public role-compatible paths are scored with 16 raw-bit signed token-junction interactions and source-oblivious normalized logmeanexp. The primary branch does NOT subtract a graph-specific shuffled null. A 22-parameter end-to-end readout includes two bounded nuisance coefficients to control depth and candidate-count calibration, with explicit penalties to prevent shortcut-only classification.

training.objective: One paired logistic ranking loss + 0.5 balanced individual BCE + 0.01 squared nuisance depth-and-candidate residual penalty per pair; optimize only FIT split, no validation tuning.
training.update: Deterministic full-batch clipped SGD; exactly one initial vector, no restarts, stopping, refitting, winner selection or architecture changes.
training.calibration: Explicit one-pass fixed affine readout fit jointly from FIT only. Holdout TRAIN_CHECK used once for reporting, never to change weights, threshold, layers, coefficients, epochs, selected vector or loss.

source_cohorts.candidate_vectors: Two independently authenticated model-free F118/F120 GenEnv vectors, fixed candidate indices 2 and 3. Source identities SHA-pinned before FIT; no reselection by TRAIN_CHECK.

structure.pairing: Every positive and negative share exact query and public topology, edge role multiset, raw-bit source/destination token marginal multisets; swap on a binding-relevant source token versus off-role decoy, and independently verify oracle path count positive 1 negative 0.

frozen_comparison.primary: TRAIN_CHECK, completely disjoint from FIT; report complete paired denominators and signed ranking/positive/negative confusion per lane AND each depth/stratum.
frozen_comparison.eligible_exact_symbolic: Mandatory strongest same-information public raw-bit exact symbolic solver; must be scored as an eligible accuracy and resource competitor, never excluded as oracle ceiling.
frozen_comparison.ablation_scoring: Diagnostic only, uses frozen FIT weights, no model selection from ablation outcomes.
frozen_comparison.baseline_information_parity: All baselines see same public graph and raw bits when native interface permits; report source/interface block explicitly rather than changing frozen algorithm or denominator.
frozen_comparison.source_provenance_and_denominator: Retain every FIT and TRAIN_CHECK case including overflow failures, ambiguous graph quarantine before learning with full rejects and no outcome-based resampling.
frozen_comparison.decision: No promotion or independent scientific success from TRAIN or TRAIN_CHECK; independent original first-use requires its own later authorization and fresh protected CONFIRM evidence.

cost_verification.primary: Shared instrumented per-graph accounting against same input on same runner, including query-edge scans, 16-bit comparisons, token feature multiply/add, hashing and sorting, state/candidate allocation, float operations, graph-null generation, and memory allocation. Each event category reported separately and mapped to a fixed common event schedule BEFORE model runs.
cost_verification.runtime: Wall clock walltime from same Python 3.11 build/host, warmed 5 complete runs and 30 measured interleaved graph passes, order alternates model and solver. Report median and p95 per model over exactly the same graphs; no cross-platform speed claims.

current_gate.scope: Immutable preimplementation freeze and source-only adversarial schema/negative-preservation/authority tests, GitHub Ubuntu plus Windows; no new TRAIN or CONFIRM cases, no new model fit.
current_gate.next: After exact-head source qualification, implement public FIT and TRAIN_CHECK family and 22-param single-graph readout plus strong controls. Run full regression before reporting, keep all research negatives.
